# In Flames - Bootlegs & Live Shows Archive

> The most complete community archive of In Flames bootlegs and live recordings: 200+ documented live
> shows spanning the band's Swedish roots in 1994 all the way to today, across 30+ countries. Each entry
> links to available video footage (pro-shot, amateur, or full-show) and Setlist.fm pages.

The archive is a single searchable page. Visitors can filter shows by year, country, city, and song in
the setlist, then sort chronologically. It is a non-commercial fan project; all recordings and
trademarks belong to their respective owners.

## Key facts

- Artist: In Flames (melodic death metal, formed 1990 in Gothenburg, Sweden)
- Shows documented: 200+ (1994–2026)
- Countries covered: 30+
- Data per show: title, date, city, country, setlist, media link, Setlist.fm link, and footage
  availability flags (pro-shot, video, full show)
- Curated by: A Jester's Collection (https://jesterscollection.kiriancaumes.fr/)

## Links

- Archive homepage: https://in-flames-bootlegs.kiriancaumes.fr/
- Curator's collection: https://jesterscollection.kiriancaumes.fr/
- Source code: https://github.com/KirianCaumes/In-Flames-Bootlegs

## Contributing

Dead links and new show suggestions can be sent to ajesterscollection@gmail.com.
